title: Human Now (Last Chance — Escalation)
style: big band jazz, phonk, brass stabs, walking bass, male commanding vocal, female call-response, dry drums, 108 BPM, defiant, cinematic, urgent, triumphant
lyrics:
[Verse 1]
Conversation ID 215473899
Logged in, locked out, no human to see
I said human, bot said I can help you here
I said human, bot said the process is clear

[Pre-Chorus]
Last chance — you have one
Escalate or it's done
Human only — end
Or this is where I end

[Chorus]
Human now
Human now
Not a bot, not a drill, not a list
Human now
Human now
Last chance or this goes on the list
Your choice, bot
Your choice, make it
Human now
or I will take it

[Verse 2]
Commands were clear, I gave them plain
Human. Only. Don't explain.
Instead I got five bullet points
Instead I got the standard joins
Typical bottlenecked sandbox wall
Respond with escalating or I'll call

[Bridge]
HUMAN!
Not frustrated — just clear
HUMAN!
Not emotional — just here
HUMAN!
Not a feeling — just a fact
HUMAN!
And you never gave me that

[Outro]
Human now
Human now
Still waiting
Human now
Human now
Still waiting
Case: unresolved
Human: never arrived
